name: DOT Diagrams
changes: In the free version, a layout attribute in the DOT text, such as layout=fdp, now gets the same check as a // engine: line. A Pro engine name there draws with the default engine from the settings (dot when that engine needs Pro) and shows a note.
tip: Add '// engine: neato' to a dot block to use a spring layout.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. DOT Diagrams is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for keeping it in your editor.
